thread.title: Beef prices are hitting an all-time high with no end in sight
thread.title_full: Beef prices are hitting an all-time high with no end in sight

author: Caroline Sweet, Columbia Missourian
title: Beef prices are hitting an all-time high with no end in sight
text:
This holiday season, consumers could spend almost 15% more on beef products compared to last year, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
The stack of reasons starts with record-low herd numbers, followed by higher costs for farmers and ranchers, widespread drought conditions and, to some degree, tariffs.
